description: Reference exchange rate between two currencies. Pass date for a past business day, amount to convert.

amount.description: Appends amount and converted, rounded to the quote currency minor-unit digits

base.description: Base currency ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Official rate for that business day. A weekend or holiday resolves to the last published day on or before it

quote.description: Quote currency ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR

name: currency_rate
title: Currency Rate
